text: {"question":"How does allowing the helium abundance to vary affect the limits on the running of the primordial spectral index, and why does this happen?","reference_answer":"When the helium fraction is left free, its impact on diffusion damping at high multipoles weakens the precision with which the tilt and running of the power spectrum can be measured, leading to broader constraints on the running parameter αs. This occurs because changes in YHe alter the damping tail of the CMB, which is otherwise used to pin down the spectral shape."}
